test_title: PYST 28: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Of or relating to the moon
solution:
The correct answer is **'Lunar'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lunar** means relating to or resembling the moon.

 
 
• Example- A **lunar** eclipse is to happen.
 
 
 
• It is clear that **'lunar'** is the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Solar** means relating to or determined by the sun.

 
 
• Example- The government is installing **solar** panels everywhere to use **solar **energy.
 
 
 
• **Platonic **means an intimate or affectionate relationship that is not sexual.
 
 
• Example- Their relationship is completely **platonic.**
 
 
 
• **Fatal **means something causing death or leading to disaster.
 
 
• Example- It was a **fatal **accident.
